concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-002 (percentage reduction in dynamic‑execution cycles) is not covered by any task or verification script; the task list contains no step that computes or reports this metric, violating the spec’s acceptance criteria.

Success Criterion SC-004 (runtime ≤ 6 h and memory ≤ 7 GB) is not verified by any task or test; there is no automated check asserting that the pipeline meets the computational feasibility constraints, leaving the criterion untested.

Task T038 writes a checksum manifest to `data/artifact_hashes.yaml`, but Constitution Principle V requires that artifact hashes be recorded in `state/projects/PROJ-953-llmxive-follow-up-extending-code-as-agen.yaml`. Introducing a separate manifest drifts from the mandated version‑tracking discipline.
